namedExpressions.$$decentIntersectionTypes: HighwayTypeCount gt 1 and HighwayType neq 'Track' and HighwayType neq 'Motorway' and (HighwayType eq 'Service' and HighwayType eq 'Unclassified') eq False and (HighwayType eq 'Service' and HighwayType eq 'Residential') eq False
namedExpressions.$$sameAngle: (current:DrivingDirectionAngle modulo 180 - DrivingDirectionAngle modulo 180) lt 20 and (current:DrivingDirectionAngle modulo 180 - DrivingDirectionAngle modulo 180) gt -20
namedExpressions.$$maybeDrivingTheOtherWay: (current:DrivingDirectionAngle modulo 180 - DrivingDirectionAngle modulo 180) gt 160 or (current:DrivingDirectionAngle modulo 180 - DrivingDirectionAngle modulo 180) lt -160
